items.description: Public homepage exposes primary booking and subscription entry points.
Public class catalogue loads active categories and services.
Public service detail exposes available dated slots for booking.
Public learning catalogue navigates to a course page with video gated for anonymous users.
Public contact form submits and persists a client message.
Customer can create an account through the public sign-up flow.
Customer email verification activates the pending registration.
Verified customer can sign in and reach the dashboard.
Anonymous visitor is redirected away from protected customer dashboard routes.
Customer can create a booking draft for an available class slot.
Booking flow presents available payment or entitlement options.
Customer can confirm a booking by applying an eligible existing entitlement.
Customer can start Stripe checkout for a booking that requires payment.
Booking payment success page reconciles a completed checkout session.
Booking confirmation screen loads after an entitlement-backed confirmation.
Subscription catalogue loads active checkout-enabled products.
Customer can start Stripe checkout from the subscription/product cart flow.
Subscription success page reconciles a completed checkout session.
Customer dashboard and membership pages show current booking and subscription state.
Customer can cancel a booking before the cancellation cutoff.
Customer cannot cancel a booking after the cancellation cutoff.
Customer can join a full-session waitlist and cancel the waitlist entry from the dashboard.
Customer can self check in from the dashboard within the configured check-in window.
Customer can initiate a password reset request.
Customer can complete password reset and the reset token is single-use.
Customer profile page loads editable account state.
Customer membership page can initiate Stripe billing portal access when eligible.
Customer is blocked from staff-only kiosk routes.
Admin can sign in through staff entry and reach the private admin area.
Non-admin users are denied admin private access.
Anonymous users are redirected away from admin private routes.
Admin dashboard loads after successful sign-in.
Admin user create/edit flow persists staff user changes.
Admin can create and update booking service/class records.
Admin sessions calendar loads active session data.
Admin can create and update calendar session records.
Admin bookings list loads operational booking data.
Admin plans/product area loads active product catalogue management state.
Admin subscriptions list loads subscription contract state.
Admin inbox loads and supports message status review.
Admin marketing campaign confirmation flow can send or surface deterministic send errors.
Admin online learning management surface loads program and video records.
Admin can access kiosk and check in a confirmed attendee.
Admin can finalize attendance from session detail.
Admin calendar shows active waitlist count without exposing manual waitlist controls.
Admin can manually add an eligible client to a session roster.
Admin can use an audited manual no-credit attendee override with a reason.
Anonymous user is redirected away from teacher routes.
Client user is redirected away from teacher routes.
Teacher can sign in and reach the teacher dashboard.
Teacher route access revalidates database account status even when a JWT remains valid.
Teacher sessions calendar loads assigned sessions.
Teacher assigned-session roster detail loads.
Teacher profile page loads.
Teacher can mutate assigned-session roster state through server actions.
Teacher cannot manage sessions assigned to another teacher.
Teacher sessions calendar shows active waitlist counts without manual waitlist controls.
Teacher can privately mark attendance from assigned session detail.
Teacher can check in a confirmed client through kiosk for a selected collective session.
Kiosk exit requires staff password re-entry.
Kiosk check-in is blocked before the configured check-in window.
Kiosk check-in is blocked after the configured check-in window.
Private class sessions are excluded from kiosk self check-in routes.
Kiosk exit locks out after repeated invalid password attempts.
Duplicate active booking attempts resolve safely without creating a second active booking.
Booking entitlement application rejects ineligible or missing plans.
Failed checkout produces a safe payment failure outcome.
Stripe-backed checkout reconciliation updates local order/payment/booking or subscription state.
Webhook-backed final payment state is visible on customer success pages.
Cancellation policy cutoff is enforced consistently in customer cancellation flow.
Expired checkout session produces a safe stale booking outcome.
Password reset token flow enforces one-time use and secure post-reset sign-in.
Health endpoint reports runtime and database readiness.
